content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the MRPL Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 29-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of MRPL to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Mangalore Refinery and Petrochemicals Limited (MRPL) for hiring engineering professionals on a fixed-term employment contract basis in various designated engineering roles across locations.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in MRPL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 16 vacancies announced under advertisement number MRPL/PFTE/2026/02, distributed across Retail Construction Engineer, Retail Engineer, and Terminal Operation Engineer positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online for MRPL posts?
faq.answer: The online application process closes on 29-10-2026. Candidates must ensure they complete their registration, document upload, and fee payment well before this deadline to avoid last-minute server issues.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree or Diploma in Civil, Mechanical, or Any Branch of Engineering with relevant years of professional experience depending on the specific post requirements.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for UR/EWS candidates?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for unreserved and Economically Weaker Section candidates is 40 years, with appropriate upper age relaxations applicable to reserved categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for MRPL Fixed Term Employment?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive an annual consolidated pay ranging between ₹ 12 to 14 Lakh per annum, determined based on their educational qualifications and relevant post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: No, candidates belonging to SC, ST, PwBD, and Ex-Serviceman categories are completely exempted from paying the application fee, whereas General, OBC, and EWS candidates must pay ₹118/-.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for MRPL Engineering posts?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises initial screening of all submitted online applications followed by a Personal Interview (PI) for shortlisted candidates based on eligibility and criteria fulfilment.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the direct link to apply online?
faq.answer: The direct application link along with the official notification PDF link is securely provided in the Important Links section of this recruitment article for easy candidate access.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website for MRPL careers?
faq.answer: Candidates can visit the official MRPL careers portal at https://www.mrpl.co.in/careers to check detailed guidelines, updates, notifications, and submit their online applications smoothly.
